details: BULWARK. Slope interlocking paired sea-green armor brow plates down toward a vertical central shield tooth. Own-left upper cheek takes one entire warm bone-painted panel. The little amber cab peeks over the upper inner brow. Keep both weapon ports real recesses with separate shelves, with a short single cannon in each. The dark bifurcated engine block, tiny amber glazing and short wide industrial shins support this defensive stance.
